Specification: This module specifies a simple one-variable counter system in which the state variable x starts at 0 and can increase by 1 while it remains less than 5. The behavior specification is given by Init /\ [][Next]_vars, so executions start in the initial state and then evolve by Next steps or stuttering steps over vars. The file also defines several action-level formulas intended to illustrate which liveness-style properties are action formulas, while comments explicitly note that certain ENABLED formulas are state-level and therefore out of scope.
